# Chapter 1

The lighthouse lamp turns once every twelve seconds. Keepers logged the wind direction at the top of every hour. A brass barometer hangs beside the stairs to the lantern room. Fog signals sounded in groups of two when visibility dropped. The station records temperature, pressure and humidity each minute.

## Section

- Water reaches each plot through a drip line laid under the mulch.
- Volunteers record rainfall every morning before the gate opens.
- The tool shed keeps spades, forks and a wheelbarrow with a spare tyre.
- Compost is turned once a week and covered when frost is forecast.
